about: Upload rules of the platforms designers share work on (openspec add-portfolio-share-and-review). Each value names the page it came from and the day it was checked. A value marked unverified wasn't confirmed on the platform's own page: checks only warn about it.

platforms.label: Dribbble
platforms.notes: Any ratio is accepted now; 4:3 at 1600 × 1200 is the grid's thumbnail shape.

platforms.label: Behance project module
platforms.notes: Modules show 1400 px wide (2800 in the lightbox); 10 MB is recommended, 50 MB is refused.

platforms.label: Behance project cover
platforms.notes: At least 808 × 632 for retina; shown at 202 × 158. Covers can't be GIFs.

platforms.label: LinkedIn document post
platforms.notes: The help page blocks automated reading; 100 MB and 300 pages are the limits LinkedIn's scheduling partners document.

platforms.label: Instagram carousel
platforms.notes: Same limits as the kit's existing Instagram formats.

platforms.label: Upwork portfolio project
platforms.notes: Recommended 1000 × 750 (4:3). The file size limit is shown only as a picture on the page.

platforms.label: Contra project cover
platforms.notes: Contra publishes no size; its project cards crop close to 4:3, so the marketplace cover is used.

platforms.label: Fiverr gig image
platforms.notes: Recommended 1280 × 769; the 4:3 marketplace cover crops a little at the top and bottom, so keep text in the middle band, or export at width 1280 and height 769.
